title: The account shell is not runnable
fault: The injection sets the account shell to /bin/false.
prompts: What happens right after the server accepts you?
hints: Read the message. The connection closed after the auth, not during it.
Ask what the server tries to start for you after the login.

reveal.wrong: The injection set the shell of the practice account to /bin/false, so the session dies right after the login.
reveal.fix: Set a runnable shell for the account with chsh or usermod, and log in again.
